meta.name: experimentation
meta.description: Designs, runs, and reads A/B tests and growth experiments — hypothesis, sample size, duration, and honest interpretation. Use this to plan a test, judge whether a result is real, build an experimentation program, decide what to test next, or diagnose why tests keep producing inconclusive or non-replicating results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并解读A/B实验,科学判断增长动作的效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想通过试验验证想法,却总搞不清结果是否可靠。
copy.tagline_en: Design and interpret A/B tests to make data-driven growth decisions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run experiments but often doubt whether the results are real.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按严格流程指导 A/B 测试设计：要求带机制的假设、单一主要指标、预设样本量与时长、护栏指标；运行中不偷看；到期后解读时区分“显著≠实际大小”，把“无结论”视为真实结果。
howto.when: 当你想规划 A/B 测试、判断结果是否真实、建立实验流程等时，会触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个测试：把定价表移到首屏能不能提升试用转化？
say.note: Claude 会要求补充假设机制、样本量和时长。

say.text: 这个测试结果显著但提升只有0.3%，该上线吗？
say.note: Claude 会帮你区分显著性与实际价值，并检查护栏指标。

say.text: 为什么我们连续三个实验都不显著？
say.note: Claude 会排查假设、样本量、时长和偷看行为。

howto.what_en: Claude strictly guides A/B test design: mechanism-based hypothesis, one primary metric, preset sample size/duration, guardrails; no mid-run peeking; final read distinguishes significance from effect size, treats 'inconclusive' as real.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to plan an A/B test, judge if a result is real, or build an experimentation program, etc.

say_en.text: Design a test: does moving the pricing table above the fold lift trial signups?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for hypothesis, sample size, and duration.

say_en.text: The result is significant but only a 0.3% lift. Should we ship it?
say_en.note: Claude will explain significance vs. effect size and check guardrails.

say_en.text: Three inconclusive experiments in a row. What's wrong?
say_en.note: Claude will review hypothesis, sample size, duration, and peeking.
